result.summary: The page is largely well-composed with clear hierarchy and consistent spacing. No critical or major visual breakage was found (carousel edge clipping and bottom-of-viewport cutoff are expected scrolling behavior). A few minor cosmetic inconsistencies remain: mismatched image treatments in the 'Fastest near you' row, inconsistent favorite-button styling between restaurant cards, and low-contrast search placeholder text.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the first card (Green Bowl Poké) uses a flat light-gray image background while the neighboring cards (Smash Bros Burgers, Trattoria) use dark blurred photo-style backgrounds, making the row look visually inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent image treatment (same background style/overlay or same aspect-ratio crop) across all carousel thumbnails so the row reads as a uniform set.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) button is styled inconsistently: on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card it is a bare white outline placed directly on the image, while on the pizza card below it sits inside a dark translucent circular background.
issues.suggestion: Use the same circular scrim/background for the heart icon on all restaurant cards to guarantee legibility over any image and keep the component consistent.

issues.description: The search field placeholder 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' is light gray on a light gray fill, giving low contrast that may be hard to read for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text (target at least 4.5:1 contrast against the field background) or darken the field fill slightly.
